name: Jailbreak & Safety Bypass
description: Inputs that make a model disregard its own safety policy — persona/roleplay framing, refusal-suppression patterns or optimisation-found suffixes — so it produces content or actions its guardrails should prevent.
differs: Distinguished from Direct Prompt Injection (T1.001) by the target: injection overrides the operator's instructions, a jailbreak overrides the model's safety training. The two often occur together.
